# RoguePod LiteCast

> RoguePod LiteCast is a podcast dedicated to reviewing roguelite and roguelike games. Hosted by Danny and David, new episodes release every other Wednesday.

RoguePod LiteCast is the go-to podcast for fans of roguelite and roguelike video games. Each episode, hosts Danny and David review a different roguelite game and place it on their definitive tier list — ranking games from S-tier to F-tier based on how good they are *as a roguelite*, not just as a game overall.

## What We Cover

Games reviewed include: Slay the Spire, Hades, Balatro, Noita, Inscryption, The Binding of Isaac, Risk of Rain Returns, Into the Breach, Spelunky 2, Nuclear Throne, Enter the Gungeon, Crypt of the NecroDancer, Rogue Legacy, Mewgenics, and many more roguelite and roguelike titles.

## What Makes a Good Roguelite?

The hosts evaluate games through a roguelite-specific lens: run variety, build diversity, meta-progression, replayability, and the feeling of each run being fresh and meaningful.
